work.next: Committed one-time API importer and entries-schema candidate: `327cbb1f`, `025704cd`; importer replay and candidate RLS tests pass. Baseline offset pagination is not snapshot-isolated; complete source-import limitations, full API/storage compatibility, query/resource acceptance and backend suites. Keep the global serve-time backend registry Mongo-only. JSONB logical equality is accepted; object key-order parity is not a client requirement.

Use provider-neutral injected authority ports; keep `serve` roles disabled until a deployment adapter supplies trusted tenant aliases/credentials, current authorization, data-router and listener composition. Keep dormant; consumer cutover, built-in signer option and production provider/recovery acceptance remain open.
Record integrated 56-check gate; standalone/index fencing, chunking, catalogues/baselines and serving compatibility remain open.

Tenant-bound JWT verification and current-grant checks pass as proofs; production credential/authority adapters, runtime configuration and tenant API router remain unconnected.
The opt-in two-tenant HTTP lab is committed at `a19b549c`; all 10 PostgreSQL lab cases pass. Keep M3 blocked until M1 full compatibility and M2 production runtime acceptance.
Reconcile durable events and evaluator/socket acceptance; do not mix with the dormant runner lane.

deferred.title: Read existing Nightscout data through its API
deferred.reason: This is a one-time database population, not ongoing NS-to-NS synchronization; no durable checkpoint is required. Use bounded pagination, duplicate-safe reruns and best-effort srvModified reconciliation. Physical hard deletes may be undetectable, so do not claim exact deletion reconciliation or raw-backup fidelity; nightscout-connect remains the separate ongoing sync pipeline.
